findings.title_en: Opening in side safety netting at material platform entrance
Unsecured stacked metal parts on elevated platform
Hanging lifting ropes and hook above work platform

summary_en: Three findings were recorded: two medium and one low. The most urgent is the unsecured metal load and the open side netting on the elevated unloading platform due to falling-object risk. Full work stoppage is not required, but close the netting, secure the load, and keep the area below the platform clear until fixed.
